description: Hands-off delegation for ZCode: the main conversation only coordinates, five cheap worker subagents do the research, writing, coding, data and review.

plugins.name: chuigong
plugins.description: 垂拱而治：主对话只做拆解、派发、裁决、汇总，调研/写作/编码/数据处理/审核全部由预置工蜂子智能体（DeepSeek Flash）执行；含究诘（需求拷问）与 sdd（严肃流程）两个流程技能

description_i18n.zh-CN: 主对话统筹委派体系：垂拱而治——主对话只做拆解、派发、裁决、汇总，工蜂子智能体（DeepSeek Flash）执行调研/写作/编码/数据/审核；含究诘（grill-me 需求拷问）与 sdd（严肃流程）
description_i18n.en-US: Coordinator-only main conversation: decompose, dispatch, adjudicate, summarize — research/writing/coding/data/review are done by worker subagents (DeepSeek Flash); includes grill-me (requirement interrogation) and sdd (strict process).
